title: Capitolo 7 · Clothes, colours and the weather — A1 review
shortDescription: Clothes and colours with gender and number agreement, shopping for clothes (sizes, prices, sales, paying), questo and quello, the weather and the four seasons, then a complete review of Chapters 1–7 and the final A1 test.
description:
Part of the official SS Europa Italian course used in our classes, for learners from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh who are going to Italy to work, study or live. Chapters 1–7 take you from zero to level A1 and Chapters 8–12 to level A2 — study them in order.

Every 60-minute class of the chapter is split into three short lessons you can study on your phone, with pictures, audio, grammar tables and exercises. Every word comes with its English and Punjabi meaning, the slides of each class are attached as PDF, and the chapter ends with a test (pass mark 60%).

This chapter also has the final A1 test (Chapters 1–7); the written part and the oral interview are done with your teacher.
objectives:
I can name clothes and colours and make them agree: una camicia bianca, i pantaloni neri
I can buy clothes: ask for my size, try them on, ask the price and pay
I can point at things with questo and quello
I can say what the weather is like and name the four seasons
I can say what I wear in each season
I can use everything from Chapters 1–7 in a real conversation (level A1)

blocks.title: Cartelli utili nei negozi italiani
blocks.body:
- **SALDI -30% / -50%** — January and July are the sales months: prices are lower.
- **CAMERINI / PROVA** — maximum 3 or 4 items at a time · *libero* (free) / *occupato* (busy).
- **CAMBIO MERCE** — always keep the receipt (lo scontrino)! You can change the size within 15–30 days.

blocks.title: 4 passi per comprare vestiti in Italia
blocks.body:
1. **Chiedere la taglia:** *Avete questa giacca nella taglia L?*
2. **Provare in camerino:** *Posso provarla? Mi sta benissimo.*
3. **Controllare il prezzo:** *Quanto viene con lo sconto?*
4. **Pagare alla cassa:** *Pago con la carta, grazie mille.*

blocks.title: Blocco 5 · Capitolo 7: vestiti, colori e meteo
blocks.body:
**Esempio completo:** «In inverno fa freddo e piove: indosso questo cappotto nero e prendo l'ombrello!»

- **Accordo colori:** bianco / bianca / bianchi / bianche · verde, marrone (-e / -i) · blu (invariabile)
- **Questo / quello:** Che taglia porta? Posso provarlo? Quanto costa? È caro / è economico!
- **Stagioni e meteo:** fa caldo / freddo · piove · nevica · c'è il sole · c'è vento · è nuvoloso

blocks.title: The situation
blocks.body: Navjot meets Sara in the street on a winter morning.

blocks.title: Dialogo: una giornata tipo in Italia (Cap. 1–7)

lines.speaker: Navjot
lines.italian: Ciao Sara! Mi sono alzato alle sette: oggi c'è il sole ma fa freddo!
lines.english: Hi Sara! I got up at seven: today it's sunny but cold!
lines.punjabi: Sat Sri Akal Sara! Main satt vaje uthia: ajj dhupp hai par thand hai!

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.italian: Hai ragione, anch'io ho messo questo cappotto grigio. Dove vai adesso?
lines.english: You're right, I've put on this grey coat too. Where are you going now?
lines.punjabi: Tu sahi kiha, main vi eh saleti kot paia hai. Hun kitthe ja riha hain?

lines.speaker: Navjot
lines.italian: Devo andare in centro: alle dieci ho un appuntamento per un lavoro part-time.

lines.punjabi: Mainu shahir de vichkar jaana hai: das vaje paart-taim kamm lai mulakat hai.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.italian: In bocca al lupo! Dopo ci vediamo al bar vicino alla piazza per un caffè?
lines.english: Good luck! Shall we meet later at the café near the square for a coffee?
lines.punjabi: Shubh kaamnavaan! Baad vich chaunk de nede kaife te kauffi lai milie?

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.body: **In bocca al lupo!** (literally "into the wolf's mouth") is how Italians say *good luck* before an exam or an interview. The answer is **Crepi!**

blocks.title: 4 stazioni pratiche: metti tutto in gioco!
blocks.body:
1. **Presentarsi:** chi sei, famiglia, città e lavoro.
2. **Comprare:** al bar o in negozio, con colori e prezzi.
3. **Orientarsi:** chiedi e spiega la strada in città.
4. **La giornata:** orari, routine riflessiva e meteo.

lessons.summary: The final A1 test: listening, vocabulary and grammar from all 7 chapters. Pass mark: 60%.

blocks.title: Test finale livello A1
blocks.body:
This is the final test of level A1. It checks everything in Chapters 1–7.

- **1. Listening** — sentences and a short story
- **2. Vocabulary** — family, time, city, work, home and weather
- **3. Grammar** — verbs, articles, prepositions, colours and questo / quello
- **4. Writing** — your complete A1 profile

You need **60%** to pass. You can repeat the test as many times as you like.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.body: The **written part** (your A1 profile) and the **final oral exam** (introduce yourself, your day and job · order at the bar, shop or buy clothes · give directions, describe your home and the weather — 3 minutes) are done **with your teacher** in the live class.
